title: Field trace preserves integrality over a coefficient ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $F\subseteq L$ be fields [def-weil-field] with $[L:F]<\infty$, and let $R\to F\to L$ be the scalar maps. If $x\in L$ satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $R$, then $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/F}(x)\in F$ also satisfies a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image of $R$. Here $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/F}(x)$ is the trace of the $F$-linear endomorphism $z\mapsto xz$ of $L$; separability is not assumed.
